name: Orientation 留学生经典开局
detailed_description:
— Game Overview —

Study Abroad: The Classic Kick-Off drops you in the land of kangaroos and koalas as a brand-new international student about to start the most pivotal chapter of your life.

Reunite with a childhood friend, make partners-in-crime for late-night adventures, and—before you realize it—shoulder a mysterious responsibility that only you can unravel.

What does “studying abroad” really mean?
Is it carefree university days, a one-way ticket you’ll only ever punch once, leaving youthful footprints in the sands of time—
or is it the search for your own compass, discovering what life truly means amid brand-new sights, sounds, and feelings?

Countless stories and relationships wait to be written.
Ready to begin your classic study-abroad opening?

— About the Game —

This is a full-motion-video (FMV) interactive drama told entirely from a first-person POV.
Your choices steer branching storylines, changing every relationship and ultimately shaping your unique ending.

— Key Features —

  • Branching Narrative – Pick your path, forge friendships (or rivalries), and watch each decision ripple through the story.

  • Time-Leap “Redo” Power – Regret a choice? Jump back to any pivotal moment and try again. Your fate is yours to rewrite.

  • Multiple Endings & Hidden Eggs – Unlock secret scenes, discover playful Easter eggs, and piece together every last mystery.

  • Authentic Campus Life – Shot on location in Australia by a crew that’s 99 % current or former international students.

And that’s only the beginning—there’s so much more we can’t wait for you to uncover inside the game…

Business / Media / Creator Inquiries
📧 pippostudio@outlook.com
